sentences.en: It is good for the health to take moderate exercise.
sentences.zh: 适量运动对健康有好处。

sentences.en: Don't go to extremes. To be moderate is important in anything.
sentences.zh: 不要走极端。无论做什么保持适度都很重要。

sentences.en: Good health consists of proper eating and moderate exercise.
sentences.zh: 良好的健康包括合理的饮食和适量的运动。
